text.arabic_uthmani: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ

words.gloss_range: sequential/explanatory connector opening the scene as proof and launching the first temporal frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening temporal condition
later past-temporal rescue pivot

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) opens the ayah as an argumentative hinge. It turns the ship scene into concrete proof after 29:64 and fuses the boundary with the first temporal frame, while the later rescue hinge mirrors it.

topics.headline: opening connector turns the scene into proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ship scene is not detached narration but evidence after the previous ayah's verdict.
topics.reason: The opening connector resumes the argument and launches the concrete scenario as explanatory proof.

topics.headline: connector fuses with the first temporal frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary connector and the first time-condition arriving as one scenario-launching unit.
topics.reason: Local clause evidence makes the first temporal frame govern the invocation response.

topics.headline: opening and rescue pivots mirror each other
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a two-part temporal architecture: crisis entry first, rescue reversal later.
topics.reason: The ayah has two connector-led temporal hinges, one at the crisis entry and one at the rescue result.

words.gloss_range: conditional-temporal particle setting a recurring crisis frame whose response is the later invocation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: closing surprise particle with the same surface form

words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) makes the boarding a recurring crisis condition whose answer is the invocation. Its later return as a surprise particle lets the same surface form move from expected danger-response to abrupt exposure.

topics.headline: recurring crisis condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the boarding is cast as a repeatable human pattern rather than a single travel report.
topics.reason: The conditional-temporal particle with the perfect plural verb sets a vivid recurring condition whose answer is the invocation.

topics.headline: first temporal pivot anticipates the closing shock
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same surface particle returns later with a different function, turning expected crisis response into abrupt exposure.
topics.reason: The first use is conditional-temporal, while the second use at word 16 is the surprise particle.

words.gloss_range: completed plural boarding into a vessel-contained danger scene, with broader riding/composition pressure kept as supporting image rather than a separate local sense
words.root_gloss_range: mounting, riding, boarding, and composed conveyance; here the governed vessel phrase selects maritime boarding and dependence on a carrier

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: governed vessel-containment phrase

words.prose: {{ar:رَكِبُوا۟}} ({{tr:rakibū}}) is completed by {{ar:فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ}} ({{tr:fī al-fulki}}), so the action is boarding into an enclosed vessel-space, not generic travel. The perfect plural form starts the same actor chain carried through call, rescue, and reversal, and the riding/composition root pressure makes their dependence on a carrier visible without replacing the local boarding sense.

topics.headline: boarding completed by vessel containment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is not generic travel; the governed vessel phrase makes bodily entry into danger trigger the invocation.
topics.reason: The verb is completed by the governed phrase {{ar:فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ}} ({{tr:fī al-fulki}}), selecting maritime boarding.

topics.headline: completed plural trigger starts the actor chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same plural group is established from the first action and carried through call, rescue, and reversal.
topics.reason: The perfect plural form supplies the first implicit subject and starts the shared actor chain.

topics.headline: riding and composition pressure becomes dependence imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices human dependence on a carrier, while local grammar keeps the selected sense to boarding rather than activating every composition branch.
topics.reason: The root family can suggest conveyance and composition, but the local governed phrase selects boarding into a vessel.

words.gloss_range: spatial containment preposition governing the vessel and making the boarding an enclosed danger-space

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the vessel governed by the preposition
later endpoint preposition

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) places the passengers inside the vessel-space. The preposition narrows the boarding scene to containment in danger, and it begins the spatial line later answered by the endpoint preposition.

topics.headline: preposition makes the ship an enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the passengers as enclosed within the vessel-space, not merely positioned on a travel object.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the vessel as the locative complement of the boarding verb.

topics.headline: containment begins the movement line
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prepositional movement from being in the vessel to being brought toward land.
topics.reason: The earlier containment preposition is answered later by the endpoint preposition.

words.gloss_range: definite invariable vessel noun, generic for the ship-domain, locally governed as the container of danger while root orbit imagery remains secondary pressure
words.root_gloss_range: ship/vessel and related turning or orbit imagery; here the concrete vessel sense is selected while circular instability remains image-pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: containment preposition governing the vessel
later rescue verb in the ship-rescue scene

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفُلْكِ}} ({{tr:al-fulki}}) is the genitive vessel complement and, because the form can be singular or plural, it reads as a recognized ship-domain rather than one counted boat. The root's orbit and whorl imagery can make the vessel feel unstable and turning, but the local boarding phrase selects the maritime vessel sense. The word also joins the familiar ship-danger, invocation, and rescue pattern seen in 10:22 and 31:32.

topics.headline: definite invariable vessel as crisis class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the vessel as a recognized crisis-space and not just one counted boat.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the containment preposition and formally stable across singular/plural use.

topics.headline: ship sense selected while turning imagery remains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the vessel as unstable and movement-bound, while the local collocation keeps ship as the selected sense rather than orbit.
topics.reason: The collocation with boarding in the vessel selects the maritime noun; orbit and whorl evidence remains image-pressure only.

topics.headline: ship wording joins the rescue formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ship is the familiar setting where danger, invocation, and rescue converge before the ayah exposes reversal.
topics.reason: The word participates in a recurrent ship-danger and rescue field, including cross-surah parallels such as 10:22 and 31:32.

words.gloss_range: completed plural invocation directed to the divine name, with claim-register pressure only coloring the crisis speech-act
words.root_gloss_range: calling, invoking, summoning, and claiming; here direct-object grammar selects invocation of the divine name, not invitation or assertion as the main sense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: direct object of the invocation
final ongoing association contrasted with the completed call

words.prose: {{ar:دَعَوُا۟}} ({{tr:daʿawū}}) takes the divine name as direct object, so the crisis produces direct invocation rather than a general belief report. Its perfect Form I shape makes the call a completed crisis act, while claim-register pressure remains secondary to the selected invocation sense.

topics.headline: calling God directly in crisis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that crisis turns immediately into direct invocation, not a general statement of belief.
topics.reason: The verb takes the divine name as its explicit direct object.

topics.headline: perfect plural call contrasts the final ongoing verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the call as a completed crisis act, in contrast with the final ongoing association.
topics.reason: The perfect Form I plural keeps the action simple and completed, while the same actor chain continues through the ayah.

topics.headline: claim-register colors the invocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a speech-act with possible claim pressure, while the local object keeps invocation as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root can move through calling and claiming, but the direct divine object selects invocation here.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the accusative object of invocation and the antecedent for exclusive devotion
words.root_gloss_range: divinity, worship, refuge, and the proper divine name; here the proper name is the direct object and singular referent of invocation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: pronoun phrase referring back to the divine name

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) is the accusative proper name directly invoked. It fixes the referent as the one called upon and then anchors the pronoun in the exclusive-devotion phrase, while worship and refuge pressure stays subordinate to the proper-name reading.

topics.headline: proper divine name as invocation object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the call is directed to the proper divine name, not to a generic deity category.
topics.reason: The proper name is accusative as the direct object of the call.

topics.headline: divine name anchors the devotion phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the divine name pivoting from direct invocation into the later pronoun of exclusive devotion.
topics.reason: The pronoun in word 9 resumes this direct object as the recipient of devotion.

topics.headline: etymological worship and refuge pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worship and refuge pressure around the name, while the local surface remains the proper name.
topics.reason: V4 lacks this root, so the etymological row is kept cautiously as pressure, not as replacement of the proper-name reading.

words.gloss_range: active plural participle describing their state while calling: actively making devotion exclusive, with purification imagery and later partnership reversal both locally relevant
words.root_gloss_range: purity, exclusivity, separation from mixture, and making something sincerely devoted; here Form IV active participle marks active exclusive devotion as a circumstantial state

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: recipient plus devotion-domain governed by the participle
later partner-making reversal

words.prose: {{ar:مُخْلِصِينَ}} ({{tr:mukhliṣīna}}) describes the callers' state while they invoke: they are actively making devotion exclusive. The participle governs the recipient and devotion-domain phrase, and its purification force sets up the later reversal into partner-making; this rescue formula is visible in passages such as 10:22.

topics.headline: active participle as the callers' state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exclusivity describes how they are calling in the crisis, not a separate later claim.
topics.reason: The accusative active participle functions as circumstantial state tied to the plural callers.

topics.headline: Form IV actively makes devotion exclusive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices active de-mixing: the devotion is being made exclusively for God in the very moment of danger.
topics.reason: The participle governs the recipient phrase and the devotion-domain, and the root imagery supports active purification.

topics.headline: exclusive devotion is later reversed by partnership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar exclusive-devotion formula becomes the setup for the final reversal into partner-making.
topics.reason: The phrase is formulaic in rescue contexts such as 10:22 and is semantically answered by the final association verb.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus pronoun assigning the recipient and exclusive direction of the purified devotion back to the divine name

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: antecedent of the pronoun
devotion-domain directed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) compresses direction and recipient into one word. The pronoun points back to the divine name, so the devotion-domain is not merely sincere in quality but assigned exclusively to Him.

topics.headline: pronoun directs devotion to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the devotion is not merely sincere in quality; it is directed exclusively to the divine recipient.
topics.reason: The preposition-plus-pronoun is governed by the participle and resumes the divine name.

words.gloss_range: definite abstract object/domain of exclusivity: the whole obligation and devotion system, not a narrow private feeling
words.root_gloss_range: religion, obligation, judgment, submission, and debt-like accountability; here the definite abstract noun names the whole devotion-domain purified for God

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: active participle governing the devotion-domain
final partner-making reversal

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدِّينَ}} ({{tr:al-dīna}}) names the definite devotion-obligation domain governed by the exclusivity participle. Its judgment, debt, and submission range gives the phrase accountability weight, while the local construction keeps it as the domain being purified for God and later violated by partner-making.

topics.headline: definite devotion-domain under exclusivity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of purification is the whole devotion-obligation domain, not a vague inward feeling.
topics.reason: The definite abstract noun is accusative as the object or specification governed by the participle.

topics.headline: judgment debt and submission pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word carries obligation and accountability pressure, while local grammar keeps it as the devotion-domain purified for God.
topics.reason: The root range includes obligation, judgment, and debt-like accountability; the local construction selects the definite domain of devotion.

topics.headline: purified devotion contrasts later partner-making
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase as a known purification formula whose durability is tested by the final association.
topics.reason: The devotion noun strongly collocates with exclusivity and is the domain violated by the final partner-making.

words.gloss_range: sequential pivot joining completed rescue to the sudden result and mirroring the opening connector

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening connector mirrored by the second connector
temporal pivot attached to the connector

words.prose: The second {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) pivots from crisis invocation into the rescue-result half of the ayah. It mirrors the opening connector but now carries the narrative toward the completed rescue and the sudden exposure.

topics.headline: second connector pivots into rescue result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the narrative hinge where completed rescue immediately opens into the sudden result.
topics.reason: The second connector attaches to the past-temporal rescue clause and scopes toward the surprise response.

topics.headline: second connector mirrors the opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah balanced by two connector-led temporal halves, crisis then rescue.
topics.reason: The second connector reprises the first connector's temporal-hinge function while moving the scene to rescue and reversal.

words.gloss_range: past-temporal particle marking the exact completed rescue moment before the sudden reversal

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening recurring temporal frame
surprise particle answering the completed rescue

words.prose: {{ar:لَمَّا}} ({{tr:lammā}}) marks the rescue as completed before the response appears. It sits between the opening recurring condition and the closing surprise particle, making the timing itself carry the argument: danger, rescue, then reversal.

topics.headline: completed rescue before the surprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reversal comes only once rescue has been completed, making safety the trigger for exposure.
topics.reason: The past-temporal particle requires the rescue event as the completed condition before the surprise clause.

topics.headline: middle pivot between two idha functions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a timing system: recurring crisis, completed rescue, then sudden reversion.
topics.reason: The particle mediates between the opening conditional use and the closing surprise use.

words.gloss_range: completed Form II rescue with an attached object pronoun; the rescue/extraction branch is local, while secrecy/private-withdrawal pressure remains secondary
words.root_gloss_range: rescue, deliverance, escape, and related extraction or private-withdrawing imagery; here Form II selects completed divine rescue of them

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: land endpoint of the rescue
object/referent carried into the final clause

words.prose: {{ar:نَجَّىٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:najjāhum}}) shifts agency from their call to divine rescue and keeps the same people as the attached object. Form II presents effected deliverance, not their self-escape, while the rescue/extraction range supports the movement toward land without turning secrecy imagery into the local sense. The rescue also joins the ship-danger pattern seen in 10:22-23, so the deliverance is immediately judged by the reversal that follows.

topics.headline: God rescues the same group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rescuing agency shifts from their call to divine action while the same people are carried as the object.
topics.reason: The verb has an implicit 3ms subject supplied by context and an attached plural object pronoun.

topics.headline: Form II completed deliverance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices rescue as an effected deliverance, not self-escape by the passengers.
topics.reason: Form II and the object suffix select completed transitive rescue.

topics.headline: rescue and private-withdrawal imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices extraction from danger, while secrecy or private-counsel branches remain secondary image-pressure rather than the local sense.
topics.reason: The local rescue frame selects deliverance; related withdrawal/secrecy imagery only reinforces extraction.

topics.headline: rescue joins the ship-to-land formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rescue as part of a recognizable ship-danger type-scene that will be judged by the immediate reversal.
topics.reason: The root pairs with ship and land fields and recurs in rescue passages such as 10:22-23.

words.gloss_range: directional endpoint preposition completing the rescue movement toward land

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier containment preposition answered by the endpoint
endpoint governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) gives the rescue a terminal direction. It completes the verb's movement toward land and answers the earlier containment preposition, turning the ayah's space from enclosure to endpoint.

topics.headline: preposition completes rescue toward land
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rescue is given a terminal direction, ending at land rather than remaining an abstract escape.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the land noun as the goal complement of the rescue verb.

topics.headline: endpoint answers containment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's movement-line from enclosure in the vessel to arrival at land.
topics.reason: The endpoint preposition answers the earlier containment phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite dry land as the rescue endpoint and safety pole, with righteousness-wordplay kept as irony rather than replacing the spatial destination
words.root_gloss_range: dry land, firmness, truthfulness, and righteousness; here the directional preposition selects dry land while righteousness pressure produces moral irony

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: directional preposition selecting land as endpoint
sudden association after landfall

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَرِّ}} ({{tr:al-barri}}) is the definite land endpoint after the directional preposition, the expected safety pole after the vessel. The root's righteousness field adds irony: they reach firm land but not faithful firmness, and the following surprise clause turns landfall into the site of betrayal.

topics.headline: definite land as safety endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices land as the recognized safety pole that should stabilize the rescued group.
topics.reason: The definite concrete noun is genitive after the endpoint preposition and functions as destination.

topics.headline: dry land carries righteousness irony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that they reach firm land but not faithful firmness, while the endpoint preposition keeps dry land as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The directional construction selects dry land; the root's righteousness field remains moral pressure and wordplay.

topics.headline: landfall becomes the site of reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the formulaic move from sea danger to land safety becomes the exact setting for betrayal.
topics.reason: Landfall clusters with rescue and invocation fields, and the following surprise clause turns the endpoint into a reversal site.

words.gloss_range: surprise particle, not the opening conditional particle, introducing the abrupt final presentation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening conditional use of the same surface
nominal surprise clause following the particle

words.prose: The second {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) is the surprise particle, not the opening condition repeated with the same function. It introduces {{ar:هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ}} ({{tr:hum yushrikūna}}) as an abrupt reveal, making the post-rescue association appear as proof after 29:64.

topics.headline: second idha is abrupt presentation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing clause is a jarring reveal, not another calm time-condition.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify this use as the surprise particle followed by a nominal clause.

topics.headline: same form shifts from expectation to shock
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated surface form bookending the ayah while changing function from recurring condition to sudden exposure.
topics.reason: The opening use is conditional-temporal, while this closing use introduces the surprise result.

topics.headline: surprise proves the prior ignorance verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sudden reversion as the behavioral proof of the previous ayah's charge.
topics.reason: The surprise clause makes the post-rescue association appear as concrete proof after 29:64.

words.gloss_range: independent plural pronoun foregrounding the same rescued group before the final predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: predicate attached to the fronted pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) foregrounds the subject before the final predicate. Arabic could have relied on the verb ending, but the independent pronoun makes the rescued callers themselves stand in front of the reversal.

topics.headline: independent pronoun foregrounds the subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rescued group is isolated before the predicate instead of being left only inside the verb ending.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun forms the subject before the imperfect predicate in the surprise clause.

topics.headline: same group carries the contradiction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people who boarded, called, and were rescued are the same people now associating partners.
topics.reason: The pronoun resumes the ship passengers and locks the final predicate onto the same referent.

words.gloss_range: ongoing Form IV theological association, left objectless and set as the diagnostic reversal of earlier exclusive devotion
words.root_gloss_range: sharing, partnership, association, and making partners; here Form IV in a theological frame names ongoing partner-making without an expressed object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier exclusive-purifying participle
exclusive devotion-domain violated by the final verb
surprise-plus-pronoun frame of the final predicate

words.prose: {{ar:يُشْرِكُونَ}} ({{tr:yushrikūna}}) closes the ayah as an ongoing, objectless predicate: there they are, associating. In the theological frame it means active partner-making, reversing the earlier exclusive-devotion phrase by dividing what had just been made for God alone. The closing shape belongs to a rescue-reversion pattern seen in 10:22 and 31:32, and within this surah it contrasts voluntary reversion after rescue with pressured association in 29:8 before 29:66 spells out the consequences.

topics.headline: ongoing association left objectless
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final action as an ongoing predicate whose object is left open, making the reversion broad rather than naming one partner.
topics.reason: The imperfect indicative predicate follows the fronted pronoun, and translation support marks the object as absent/absolute.

topics.headline: Form IV partner-making reverses exclusivity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verb actively parcels out what the earlier exclusivity phrase had made single for God.
topics.reason: The theological frame selects association rather than ordinary sharing, and Form IV makes partner-making the active reversal of exclusive devotion.

topics.headline: closing verb joins rescue-reversion formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closure as a recognizable post-deliverance reversion pattern, not a generic final verb.
topics.reason: The closing shape recurs in rescue scenes such as 10:22 and 31:32.

topics.headline: voluntary reversion points backward and forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final association sharpening culpability within the surah and pressing forward into the next ayah's consequence verbs.
topics.reason: The same root appears under pressure in 29:8, while the final verb is answered by consequence language in 29:66.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ ... إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ ... يُشْرِكُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The vessel amid unstable water removes ordinary supports, so address, allegiance, and obedience are filtered to one recipient. Rescue transfers the riders to dry land, where the field of possible partners reopens.

activation_trace.role: The ship is the literal carrier whose exposure supplies the bounded crisis chamber.
Agitated back-and-forth water supplies the instability that strips away usable supports.
Calling and verbally inclining toward an addressee makes the crisis response relational rather than merely inward.
Purification after admixture makes exclusive devotion a filtered state produced under pressure.
Obedience and submission identify what is temporarily concentrated on God.
Rescue by separation supplies the decisive transfer out of the threatening medium.
Dry land is the literal zone in which ordinary agency and alternatives return.
Partnership restores multiple claimants to an allegiance that had just been singular.

changed_reading.before: They pray sincerely during danger and relapse after reaching shore.
changed_reading.after: The verse is a pressure-filter experiment: unstable passage concentrates address and obedience on one recipient, while restored land agency reopens a portfolio of partners.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus aligns two separation processes: the riders enact a devotional clearing, and God enacts bodily extraction. Their immediate partnership on land shows that physical release can succeed while durable release of allegiance fails.

activation_trace.role: Escape from an entanglement casts their professed devotion as an attempted inward disentangling.
Exclusive specification apart from partnership names the devotional separation at issue.
Actual rescue by separation provides the successful bodily counterpart.
Renewed participation marks reattachment after bodily extraction.

changed_reading.before: Sincerity, rescue, and relapse are three successive facts.
changed_reading.after: The sequence compares two extractions: God completes the physical one, but the human clearing of allegiance does not remain complete.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا ... فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ ... إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The circular branch of the vessel root and the two abrupt condition markers activate a recurrent circuit rather than a single anecdote: enter exposure, concentrate allegiance, exit exposure, redistribute allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Riding or taking on an affair supplies entry into a condition, not only mounting a conveyance.
Circular motion supplies the exploratory image of a behavioral return loop.
Habit or customary state lets devotion be tested as condition-dependent practice.
Land is the alternating environmental pole opposite the vessel.
Partnership is the recurrent post-crisis state to which the circuit returns.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports one abrupt contradiction between sea and shore.
changed_reading.after: The verse can model a renewable condition-cycle in which environmental rotation repeatedly rotates the distribution of allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening assay frame and its pressure-responsive professions revise the focus sincerity from proof of settled identity into a real but local assay state. Crisis reveals what dominates when alternatives fail, while the post-crisis exit reveals what persists.

activation_trace.role: Purity after mixture remains a genuine local concentration, but context tests its duration.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the governing distinction between a pressured disclosure and an untested claim.
Repeated assay makes temporal persistence part of what the disclosure must establish.
Affliction supplies a social-pressure case in which declared affiliation changes with perceived danger or aid.
A visible entrance with a concealed exit gives the profession a structure of public entry and latent withdrawal.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 place professed faith under repeated testing before the focus scene.
29:10-11 juxtapose declarations made under affliction and after aid with the naming of hypocrisy.
The focus itself gives two rapid state disclosures, one in danger and one after rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, pressure-sensitive declarations, and a concealed-exit image; I infer that each condition discloses a locally real allegiance without by itself proving continuity. A live alternative is that the sea declaration is wholly insincere rather than sincere but unstable.

changed_reading.before: Emergency sincerity is either accepted as true or dismissed as hypocrisy.
changed_reading.after: Emergency sincerity is assay evidence: it truthfully exposes the current hierarchy of dependence, while the shore response separately exposes that the hierarchy was not stabilized.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier rescues repeatedly separate persons from flood, fire, and a doomed settlement. The focus therefore joins a surah-wide extraction series in which removal from a hazard is demonstrably effective but does not by itself settle the rescued person's later allegiance.

activation_trace.role: The focus rescue is literal extraction from the maritime threat.
Noah's extraction supplies an earlier successful rescue through the same root.
A ship cutting the face of the water supplies the earlier vessel-rescue template.
Extraction from fire shows that the rescue mechanism is separation from danger, not water-specific escape.
Promised extraction of Lot and his household introduces the boundary of who is carried out.
The repeated household rescue confirms extraction while preserving an explicit exception.

structural_cues: 29:14-15 pair flood, companions, ship, rescue, and an enduring sign.
29:24 and 29:32-33 repeat rescue across unlike hazards and specify the rescued set.
29:65 repeats rescue but uniquely foregrounds what the beneficiaries do immediately afterward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated extraction verb across several hazards; I infer that the focus asks what rescue can and cannot transform. A live alternative is that the repetitions only demonstrate divine power and are not meant to distinguish bodily from devotional change.

changed_reading.before: The rescue merely ends the sea danger before the relapse.
changed_reading.after: Rescue is one member of a repeated extraction technology: it reliably changes location and survival status, while 29:65 isolates its non-guarantee of durable allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The weak spider-house and the call to beings besides God turn shore-side partnership into refuge construction. Once the vessel crisis ends, the riders do not simply forget; they rebuild a distributed shelter from relationships whose protective structure is intrinsically weak.

activation_trace.role: The literal ship is an actually functioning shelter and carrier during exposure.
Partnership supplies the post-rescue distribution of protective or devotional claims.
The weaving spider supplies the maker of a visibly organized but inadequate refuge.
Dwelling and shelter make reliance architectural rather than merely doctrinal.
Weakness of force marks the substitute shelter's failure under real load.
Calling and inclining verbally links the substitute objects directly to the focus act of calling.
Calling an other besides God supplies the alternative addressee set that partnership repopulates.

structural_cues: 29:41 defines reliance on other protectors through a house analogy.
29:42 immediately returns to what is called besides God.
29:65 contrasts a functioning vessel under danger with renewed partnership after reaching land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a real carrier, a weak constructed shelter, and calls to others; I infer that partners function as a shore-side protection architecture. A live alternative is that the spider-house targets patronage generally without specifying the motives behind 29:65.

changed_reading.before: On land they resume abstract polytheistic worship.
changed_reading.after: On land they resume building a distributed refuge system, replacing the rescuer with a web of protective claims precisely when immediate exposure has receded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The migration and provision cluster makes land the return of planning, carrying, allocation, and perceived control. Partnership can therefore be read as distributed reliance across a resource network, while the surrounding verses counter it with spacious earth, creatures that do not carry their provision, entrusted dependence, and divinely expanded or narrowed allotment.

activation_trace.role: Dry land supplies the domain where storage, routes, and ordinary provision management resume.
Partnership supplies the distribution of reliance among multiple perceived providers.
Spatial breadth counters the idea that dependence must remain fixed to one local support system.
Reliance and entrustment supply the alternative posture toward uncertain movement and livelihood.
Literal carrying foregrounds the burden of securing and transporting provision.
Apportioned giving relocates provision from the carrier's possession to an assigned supply.
Expansion and abundance supply one pole of changing material capacity.
Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the opposite pole of material capacity.

structural_cues: 29:56-60 move from spacious land and migration to reliance and the creature that does not carry its provision.
29:62 places expansion and restriction of provision under one agency.
29:65 locates renewed partnership exactly at the return to land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies land, carrying, apportioned provision, reliance, and variable abundance; I infer that shore restores a resource-control calculus and that partnership distributes dependence within it. A live alternative is that the provision cluster addresses migration independently of the focus relapse.

changed_reading.before: Comfort after rescue causes a vague return to old beliefs.
changed_reading.after: Land reactivates the practical economy of carrying and controlling provision, so partnership becomes a strategy of distributed reliance that the context directly contests.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence repeatedly obtains the correct answer, God, yet pairs it with turning away, distraction, play, and post-rescue enjoyment. Activated by the circular vessel branch, the focus becomes the crisis phase of a larger recognition cycle: right naming is available, but ordinary absorption rotates conduct away from its implication.

activation_trace.role: Circular motion supplies the exploratory shape of recurring recognition and diversion.
The crisis call is the cycle's most concentrated act of correct address.
Naming the worshipped God as creator supplies correct explicit recognition before the focus.
Being turned from a proper direction supplies the directional failure that follows correct naming.
Repeated naming of God after rain and revived earth confirms that recognition is available outside maritime crisis too.
Occupation by something else supplies the mechanism that displaces recognized priority.
Action without a sound governing aim supplies conduct detached from acknowledged truth.
Enjoyed benefit supplies the post-rescue absorption through which denial is prolonged.

structural_cues: 29:61 and 29:63 repeat that they will say God when asked about creation and rain.
29:64 inserts distraction and play immediately before the focus.
29:66 grammatically continues the focus with denial of what was given and enjoyment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated correct naming, directional turning, diversion, and enjoyed benefit; I infer a recurring recognition-displacement circuit and use the circular vessel image only as its exploratory shape. A live alternative is a linear accusation of inconsistency with no cyclic implication.

changed_reading.before: Sea danger uniquely produces knowledge or recognition that disappears on shore.
changed_reading.after: Recognition is already present across ordinary creation, crisis, and rescue; what rotates is whether conduct remains governed by that recognition once diversion and benefit resume.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next security scene sharpens the shore transition into a problem of credit assignment. A bounded safe sanctuary exists amid people being snatched away around it, yet belief is assigned to falsehood and God's favor is denied. The focus partnership can thus name the reassignment of rescue and security credit after safety is received.

activation_trace.role: Divine extraction supplies the received safety whose attribution is at stake.
Land supplies the apparent secure zone in which causal credit is redistributed.
Partnership divides credit among claimants after a singular rescue.
A bounded sanctuary supplies concrete protected geography rather than generic comfort.
Security and trusting belief are paired within one root occurrence, exposing the relation between felt safety and assigned trust.
Rapid snatching supplies the surrounding counterfactual danger against which sanctuary safety is visible.
The area around a thing maps protection as a center encircled by exposure.
Loss of truth and stability marks the false recipient to which belief or credit is assigned.

structural_cues: 29:66 links the rescue to denial of what was given.
29:67 contrasts a safe bounded center with abduction around it.
The same verse opposes belief in falsehood to denial of God's favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received rescue, sanctuary security, surrounding seizure, falsehood-belief, and rejected favor; I infer that 29:65's partnership redistributes causal credit for safety. A live alternative is that 29:67 offers a separate civic sign rather than specifying the psychology of the shore response.

changed_reading.before: They become polytheists again once geographically safe.
changed_reading.after: Received safety becomes the very occasion for misattribution: singular rescue is converted into divided credit within a protected land system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing effort, guidance, and paths convert the focus's short emergency passage into a duration test. Exclusive obedience is not only a call at the point of exposure; it must become a guided route carried through changing conditions.

activation_trace.role: Literal riding supplies a bounded journey whose allegiance changes with terrain.
Submission supplies the orientation that must persist beyond the emergency segment.
Exerting capacity under hardship extends the test from reactive danger to sustained effort.
Gentle direction toward a road or truth supplies continuing orientation after the crisis.
Traversable extended paths pluralize the terrain without pluralizing the governing allegiance.

structural_cues: 29:65 moves from riding to land and changes allegiance at the boundary.
29:69 closes the surah with effort followed by guidance into God's paths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a short ride, exertion, guidance, and extended paths; I infer that durable sincerity is route-shaped rather than a momentary emergency peak. A live alternative is that 29:69 promises guidance generally without directly contrasting the riders.

changed_reading.before: The defect is that a sincere emergency moment is followed by a bad moment.
changed_reading.after: The defect is discontinuity of route: allegiance is concentrated at one hazardous segment but is not carried across the terrain change into sustained guided practice.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the truth-and-effective-action branch of ب ر ر inside the ordinary noun for dry land. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and in the immediate contrast between spoken devotion and subsequent action. Downstream prose should present it as lexical resonance, not assert that البر literally means moral truth here.

activation_trace.role: Dry land supplies the certain surface meaning and the scene of post-rescue conduct.
Truth that carries speech into action activates an ethical test at the same lexical landing point.
The sea call supplies the prior speech whose practical truth is tested after landing.
Renewed partnership supplies the action that fails to carry the singular call forward.

changed_reading.before: The shore is only the safe location where inconsistency appears.
changed_reading.after: The shore also resonates as the point where a spoken claim must become truth-bearing action, and the immediate partnership records its failure to do so.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's secondary mapping from د ع و to د ع ع and its images of violent pushing and successive collapse. It remains anchored in the focus call and the agitated vessel setting, where pressure visibly precedes address. Downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for compelled salience, never as the lexical definition of دعوا.

activation_trace.role: Agitated coming and going supplies the physical pressure field around the call.
Violent pushing supplies an exploratory image of danger forcing one dependence to the foreground.
Successive falling supplies an exploratory cascade in which supports fail one after another until one addressee remains.
Purity after admixture names the resulting concentration once competing supports have fallen away.

changed_reading.before: Fear simply motivates a voluntary prayer.
changed_reading.after: The danger can be pictured as mechanically pushing and collapsing the support hierarchy until exclusive address is the remaining live response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it overlays later eschatological enclosure on a concrete sea-to-land rescue. It remains anchored in نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ, whose mechanism is movement from inside danger to an apparent outside. Downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial analogy: the later verses challenge the finality of shore, not the reality of the maritime rescue.

activation_trace.role: Rescue by separation supplies movement out of one enclosing hazard.
Dry land supplies the apparent outside and endpoint of the local danger.
Enclosure by overpowering destruction supplies a later condition with no secure exterior.
A covering that generally envelops supplies the return of total exposure.
The upper direction closes one side of the imagined escape space.
The lower direction closes the opposite side of the imagined escape space.

changed_reading.before: Reaching shore is an unqualified move outside danger.
changed_reading.after: Shore is a real local outside but not a final outside: the larger spatial field can close again above and below, making renewed partnership a false inference from temporary clearance.

strongest_changes: The testing frame recasts crisis sincerity as a locally true assay result rather than proof of stable identity.
Repeated rescues distinguish reliable bodily extraction from the unresolved transformation of allegiance.
The provision cluster and the sanctuary contrast make land a domain of resumed control, distributed reliance, and reassigned credit for safety.
Repeated correct naming, turning, diversion, and enjoyment expand the sea-shore reversal into a recognition cycle.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a dense interaction between the focus's two separation roots, the earlier rescue series, the spider-house model of substitute protection, and the immediate creation-provision-sanctuary sequence. It supported several coexisting mechanisms instead of reducing the ayah to generic inconsistency.
remaining_uncertainties: The circular فلك activation may be a useful branch resonance without implying that the verse itself encodes recurrence.
The ethical ب ر ر reading is anchored but should remain a lexical echo beside the certain dry-land sense.
The resource-control reading depends on treating the nearby migration and provision sequence as causal illumination of shore-side partnership.
The secondary د ع ع mapping explains pressure-driven salience only as an exploratory material analogy.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Mounted vulnerability strips away layered allegiance.** ر ك ب B001 is mounting and riding, B002 is overlap and superposition, and B003 is undertaking or being burdened by a matter. Riding within the ship places people inside layered support over danger; there they call with exclusive devotion, but rescue to land restores association. I infer that acute burden collapses competing layers of claimed support; the voyage reads as an assay that reveals a latent singular orientation which safety re-covers.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:67 provides a land-based analogue to shipboard rescue: secure space amid surrounding seizure. The repeated failure is therefore not confined to sea; granted safety repeatedly gets detached from its giver.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Marine danger strips competing affiliations, while rescue restores the conditions for divided allegiance.** Lexical evidence: `رَكِبُوا`, root `ر ك ب`, `B003` (undertaking and being burdened by a matter); `ٱلْفُلْك`, root `ف ل ك`, `B003` (ship moving on water); `دَعَوُا`, root `د ع و`, `B001` (calling to draw near); `مُخْلِصِين`, root `خ ل ص`, `B001` (purification into unmixed clarity) with `B004` (exclusive separation from sharing); `ٱلدِّين`, root `د ي ن`, `B001` (obedience and submission); and `يُشْرِكُون`, root `ش ر ك`, `B001` (sharing and partnership). Structural cue: shipboard burden yields exclusive submission; deliverance to land triggers an immediate `إِذَا` reversal into partnership. Assigned role: danger removes imagined alternatives; rescue changes the pressure field; partnership re-enters when safety permits. Abductive move: the packet supplies temporal reversal, and I infer that circumstance rather than settled conviction regulates their purity. Reading change: sincerity is shown as situational de-mixing that fails to survive changed conditions.

2. **The dry land tests whether the shipboard word will hold true.** Lexical evidence: `نَجَّاهُم`, root `ن ج و`, `B001` (deliverance by separation), and `ٱلْبَرّ`, root `ب ر ر`, surface-supported `B005` (land and open dry country) with dormant `B001` (truth that makes word or deed hold). Structural cue: rescue transfers them from ship to dry land; association immediately contradicts their prior exclusive submission. Assigned role: land is the new test environment; the truth/holding branch measures continuity between crisis-word and safe-land deed. Abductive move: this is a latent activation: `البر` denotes dry land directly, while the truth branch is awakened by the broken word-deed relation. Reading change: arrival on land becomes an assay of whether declared purity has structural hold.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later confirmation (`29:67`):** Protected sanctuary repeats the same safety-triggered contradiction at communal scale: people inhabit `ء م ن B001` yet attach `ء م ن B002` to voidness. The ship-land reversal is therefore not an isolated episode but a stable pattern of pressure-regulated allegiance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Unstable Vessel and the Purified Call
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Passengers mount a vessel, waves destabilize its course, entanglement strips away alternatives, and a single unalloyed call is directed outward.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: mounting a vessel or conveyance `quranic:root_000589:B001/m01`; layers riding one above another `quranic:root_000589:B002/m01`; vessel moving on water `quranic:root_001177:B003/m01`; wave moving back and forth `quranic:root_001177:B007/m01`; vocal summons that inclines an addressee `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`; obedience and religious submission `quranic:root_000504:B001/m01`; purification after mixture `quranic:root_000430:B001/m01`; escape from entanglement `quranic:root_000430:B002/m01`; exclusive devotion without partnership `quranic:root_000430:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Sea danger removes the illusion of stable mounting: vessel, wave, and passenger are all layers riding unstable layers. إخلاص is a filtering operation in which mixed allegiances fall away until one addressee remains.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dry-Ground Rescue and Renewed Division
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Extraction reaches safe dry land; once the snare is gone, allegiance is repartitioned and the received benefit is disowned.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: escape by separation `quranic:root_001476:B001/m01`; raised ground beyond inundation `quranic:root_001476:B004/m01`; dry land opposed to sea `quranic:root_000104:B005/m01`; shared ownership or partnership `quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`; assigning a partner in worship `quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`; divided inward opinion `quranic:root_000791:B008/m01`; denial of a received benefit `quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`; disavowal after attachment `quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rescue is a movement from unstable water to raised, dry footing. Precisely when the environment becomes divisible and controllable again, the previously purified relation is divided into shares and the saving benefit is repudiated.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanın bir hayvana ya da tekneye binmesini ve onun üzerinde veya içinde bulunmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; binen kişi, yolcu topluluğu, binilen hayvan veya taşıt ve binmeye yarayan donanım bu çekirdeğe bağlı adlandırmalardır. Ödünç atla savaşa katılan kişi de binme ilişkisinin özel bir uygulamasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçek bir binme ilişkisiyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin üst üste gelmesi, parçaların takılması ve aynı kökten gelen beden adları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel binme eylemini ayrı tutar; eyer parçası, taşınan yağ ve ödünç atla savaşma gibi belirli kuruluşlara bağlı anlamları genel eyleme katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın bir hayvana ya da tekneye binmesi ve onun üzerinde veya içinde bulunmasıdır. Binen kişi ve topluluk, binilen hayvan veya taşıt, binmeye yarayan eyer parçası ve başkasının atıyla savaşa katılma bu ilişkinin bağlı kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: İnsan, bir hayvana ya da tekneye biner ve onun üzerinde veya içinde bulunur.
Binen kişi veya topluluk, binilen araç ve binmeyi sağlayan donanım aynı ilişki üzerinden adlandırılır.
Başkasının atını kullanarak savaşa katılan kişi, binme ilişkisinin özel bir insan rolüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, bir insanın hayvana ya da tekneye binmesi ve onun üzerinde veya içinde bulunması ile bu ilişkideki yolcu, topluluk, binek, taşıt ve donanım adlarıdır; ödünç atla savaşma özel bir uygulama olarak buna bağlanır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: يقال ركب ركوبا يركب والركاب المطي (maqayis); الركوب في الأصل كون الإنسان على ظهر حيوان وقد يستعمل في السفينة (mufradat); الركبان والأركوب والركب فراكبو الدابة وركاب السفينة الذين يركبونها (ayn;tahdhib); الركاب الإبل التي يسار عليها والركوب والركوبة ما يركب (sihah;tahdhib); ركاب السرج معروف (jamhara;sihah;tahdhib); المركب الذي يغزو على فرس غيره (maqayis;ayn;jamhara;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı, bir şeyin başka bir şeyin üstüne çıkması ve parçaların üst üste yığılması ekseninde kurar. Yağ katmanları, bulutların yığılması ve rüzgarların bulutlarla ilişkisi bu çekirdeğin örnekleri veya belirli kuruluşlara bağlı uzantılarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üstte bulunma veya üst üste yığılma yeterlidir; insanın bir binekle yol alması ya da bir parçanın başka bir parçaya takılıp sabitlenmesi bu dala dahil değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel üstte bulunma anlamı korunur; yağ katmanları ve rüzgarlarla bulutları ilişkilendiren söz öbekleri yalnızca kendi kuruluşlarında geçerli özel örneklerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başka bir şeyin üstüne çıkması ya da çok sayıda parçanın birbirinin üzerine gelerek katman veya yığın oluşturmasıdır. Yağ tabakaları, biriken bulutlar ve bulutlarla ilişkilendirilen rüzgarlar bunun özel görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Bir varlık başka bir varlığın üstünde bulunur veya parçalar üst üste gelir.
Yağ katmanları ile biriken bulutlar, üst üste gelmenin doğal oluşumlardaki örnekleridir.
Rüzgarların bulutları taşıyan ya da onların üstünde bulunan güç olarak anlatılması bu görüntüye bağlı bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, üstte bulunma ve parçaların üst üste gelmesi çekirdeğini; yağ katmanları, bulut yığınları ve rüzgarların bulutlarla kurduğu ilişki gibi bağlı örneklerle birlikte verir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın çekirdeği çoklu parçaların yığılmasıdır; odak dal daha geniş olarak tek bir şeyin başka bir şeyin üstünde bulunmasını ve katmanlaşmayı da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Parçaların sabitlenmeden yalnızca üstte bulunması veya yığılması yeterlidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir parçanın belirli bir yere sokulması, takılması ya da sabitlenmesi gerekir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir katılımcı düzeni vermez: kişi bir işi ya da suçu işler, başka birine iş yükler, borç kişinin üzerine çöker ve bir görevli vergi toplayanlara haksızlık eder. Dal korunabilir, ancak gönüllü üstlenme ile dışarıdan yüklenme ve baskı altına girme açıkça ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, işe girişme veya bir yükün kişiyi kuşatması çevresindedir; fiziksel binme anlamı değildir ve gönüllü sorumluluk ile zorlayıcı borç yükü özdeş sayılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel bir tek sözcüklü anlam varsayılmaz; işi işleme, birine yükleme, borç altında kalma ve vergi görevlilerine haksızlık etme ayrı kuruluşlar olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir işe veya suça girişmek, birine bir iş yüklemek ya da borç gibi bir yükün kişiyi baskı altına almasıdır. Vergi toplayan görevlilere haksız yük çıkaran kişi, bu baskı ilişkisinin özel bir insan rolüdür.

facets.statement: Kişi bir işe veya suça girişir ve onu gerçekleştirir.
İş ya da borç bir kişiye yüklenir ve onu baskı altında bırakır.
Vergi toplayan görevlilere gerçekte topladıklarından fazlasını yükleyen kişi, ilişkinin haksız uygulayıcısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, işe veya suça girişme ile iş ya da borcun kişiye yüklenmesi arasındaki katılımcı değişimini birlikte gösterir; vergi toplayanlara haksız yük çıkaran görevli bunun özel örneğidir.

concept_gloss.text: işe girişme, yükleme veya yük altında kalma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın gönüllü eylem, başkasına yük bindirme ve borç gibi bir yükün kişiyi kuşatması yönlerini birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemi gerçekleştirme ile yükleyen ve yüke maruz kalan katılımcı düzenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: bir işi ya da suçu işlemek
contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin kendi eylemiyle bir işe veya suça giriştiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin bir eyleme girişip onu gerçekleştirmesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Başkasına yük bindirme, borç altında kalma ve haksız görevli rolünü karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Borcun kişiyi kuşattığı ve baskı altına aldığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan gelen yükün kişiyi baskı altına alması yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin işe girişmesi ve bir başkasına iş yüklenmesi yönlerini karşılamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: birine iş yüklemek; işi ya da suçu işlemek
vergi toplayan görevlilere haksız yük çıkaran kişi

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin bir işe isteyerek girişmesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Suç işleme, başkasına yük bindirme ve kişinin borç altında istemeden kalması yönlerini siler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İş veya suç işleme, borcun kişiyi kuşatması ve haksız vergi görevlisi rolü de vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İleti, emanet veya ahlaki yükü kabul edip hakkını yerine getirme ya da ona ihanet etme yönünü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin bir yük veya sorumlulukla ilişkiye girmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal güvene dayalı bir görevin veya ahlaki yükün taşınmasına odaklanır; odak dal ise işi ya da suçu işlemeyi, yüklemeyi ve borç altında kalmayı kapsayan daha değişken bir katılımcı düzenine sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Borç dışındaki işler, suçlar ve başkasına haksız yük bindirme durumlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle borç ve emanetlerin kişiyi ağırlaştırmasını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: borç altında kalma ile borçla ağırlaşma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda borç kişinin üzerinde ağır ve baskı kuran bir yük haline gelir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın çekirdeği borç ve emanetle ağırlaşmadır; odak dalda bu yalnızca bir uzantıdır ve aynı dal iş veya suç işleme ile başkasına yükleme ilişkilerini de içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sağlanan on yedi adayın tamamı değerlendirildi. Sorumluluk taşıma ve borçla ağırlaşma adayları dalın iki temel katılımcı düzenini en iyi ayırdığı için seçildi; diğerleri sonuç, karşıt durum veya yalnızca genel yük alanını paylaşıyordu.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir parçayı başka bir nesnedeki yerine geçirip sabitlemeyi çekirdek işlem olarak açıkça kurar. Yüzük taşı ve mızrak ya da ok ucu örnekleri bu işlemi somutlaştırır; takılmış parça ve parçaların düzgün birleşimi de işlemin sonucu olarak adlandırılır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yerine geçirme ve sabitleme kurucudur; yalnızca üstte durma veya yığılma yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Parça takma işlemi ile takılmış parça ve düzenli birleşim ayrı tutulur; yüzük taşı ve silah ucu örnekleri bütün dalın tek zorunlu nesnesi sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir parçayı başka bir nesnenin içindeki ya da üzerindeki belirli yerine geçirip sabitlemek ve böylece parçaları düzenli bir bütün halinde birleştirmektir. Takılan parça da bu işlemin sonucu olarak adlandırılabilir.

facets.statement: Bir parça, taşıyıcı nesnedeki belirli yerine geçirilir ve orada sabitlenir.
Yerine takılmış parça ve parçaların düzenli birleşimi, işlemin sonucu olarak adlandırılır.
Yüzük taşının yuvasına ve metal ucun mızrak ya da oka takılması işlemin belirgin örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir parçanın belirli bir yere geçirilip sabitlenmesini ve takılmış parçanın ya da oluşan düzenli birleşimin bu işlem üzerinden adlandırılmasını ortak biçimde destekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir parçanın başka bir nesnedeki yuvasına veya bağlantı yerine takıldığı bütün bağlamlarda çekirdek işlemi karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Parçanın belirli yere geçirilmesi ve orada sabitlenmesi işlemlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yüzük taşı, ok ucu veya benzeri bir parçanın taşıyıcı nesneye bağlandığı eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Parçayı belirli bağlantı yerine geçirme ve sabitleme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Takılmış parçanın adı ile bütünün düzenli birleşim niteliğini doğrudan karşılamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir parçayı bir şeyin içine yerleştirip sabitlemek

error_profile.preserves: Birden çok parçanın tek bir bütün oluşturması sonucunu korur.
error_profile.adds: Parçanın belirli bir yere geçirilip sabitlenmediği her türlü birleştirme işlemini kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Genel toplama ve bağlama işlemleriyle karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir parçanın belirli bir yuvaya ya da bağlantı yerine geçirilip sabitlenmesini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dağınık öğeleri toplama, metin oluşturma ve farklı parçaları sıralama gibi daha genel birleşimleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da ayrı parçaların bir bütün içinde ilişkilendirilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal parçaları toplama ve düzenleme bakımından geniştir; odak dalda ise bir parçanın taşıyıcı nesnedeki belirli yerine geçirilip sabitlenmesi kurucu koşuldur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yüzük taşı veya ok ucu dahil her tür parçanın yerine takılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Mızrak ya da okun altına belirli bir metal parça eklenmesini ve o parçanın kendisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genel parça takma ile mızrak ucu ekleme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir silah gövdesine metal bir parçanın takılmasını içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal belirli bir silah parçası ve onu ekleme işlemiyle sınırlıdır; odak dal ise bu örneği daha genel bir yerine geçirip sabitleme işleminin örneği olarak kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sağlanan on yedi adayın tamamı değerlendirildi. Genel birleştirme ile belirli silah parçası ekleme, dalın işlem sınırlarını en açık gösteren adaylardır; diğerleri biçim, araç veya uzak kardeş anlam düzeyinde kalmıştır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insan ve hayvandaki diz eklemini, dizin iri veya kusurlu oluşunu ve dize ya da dizle vurma eylemini aynı beden odağı çevresinde verir. Beden parçası çekirdektir; büyüklük niteliği ve vurma eylemi ona bağlı kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca diz eklemi ve doğrudan dizle kurulan nitelik veya vurma ilişkileriyle sınırlıdır; bacağın tamamını ya da başka eklemleri kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Diz adı çekirdek tutulur; iri veya kusurlu diz niteliği ile dize ya da dizle vurma eylemi ayrı biçimlere bağlı uzantılar olarak genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: İnsan veya hayvandaki diz eklemi ve bu eklemin belirgin büyüklük ya da kusur göstermesidir. Birinin dizine vurmak veya kendi diziyle ona vurmak da aynı beden odağına bağlı eylemdir.

facets.statement: İnsan veya hayvanın bacağındaki diz eklemi temel gönderimdir.
Dizin olağandan iri ya da kusurlu olması beden parçasına bağlı bir niteliktir.
Birinin dizine vurmak veya kendi diziyle vurmak aynı beden parçasını eylemin aracı ya da hedefi yapar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, insan ve hayvandaki diz eklemini, dizin iri veya kusurlu oluşunu ve dize ya da dizle vurma eylemini tek beden odağı çevresinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: diz eklemi ve dizle kurulan vurma ilişkisi
concept_gloss.applicability: Beden parçasını çekirdek alır; dizin niteliğini ve dizin vurma eylemindeki hedef veya araç rolünü de görünür kılar.

error_profile.preserves: Diz eklemini, diz niteliğini ve dize ya da dizle vurmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan veya hayvandaki beden ekleminin doğrudan adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Beden parçası olan diz eklemini eksiksiz karşılar.
error_profile.loses: Dizin iriliği veya kusuru ile dize ya da dizle vurma eylemlerini tek başına anlatmaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: dizi iri ya da kusurlu olan
dizine vurmak ya da kendi diziyle vurmak

error_profile.preserves: Dizin bağlı bulunduğu beden bölgesini yaklaşık olarak gösterir.
error_profile.adds: Diz dışındaki üst ve alt bacak bölümlerini de kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Belirli eklemi bütün uzuvla karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dizin kendisini, büyüklük veya kusurunu ve dizle vurmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Alın, burun, eller, ayaklar ve dizler dahil yere değen bütün beden bölümlerini ve izlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: diz ile yere değen beden bölümleri
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Diz, yere kapanma sırasında kullanılan beden bölümlerinden biri olarak iki dalın alanında bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal bir eylemde yere değen beden bölümlerinin takımını anlatır; odak dal ise tek başına diz eklemini ve ona bağlı nitelik ile vurma eylemini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dizi beden parçası ve vurma aracı ya da hedefi olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dirsek, omuz ucu, topuk ve başın arkası gibi bayıltıcı darbe yerlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Diz, darbenin yöneltilebildiği hassas bir beden noktası olarak iki dalda da yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın çekirdeği bayıltıcı darbenin uygulanabildiği çeşitli yerlerdir; odak dalın çekirdeği diz eklemidir ve vurma yalnızca bu ekleme bağlı bir uzantıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sağlanan on yedi adayın tamamı değerlendirildi. Dizle doğrudan kesişen beden bölümleri ve darbe noktası adayları yayımlandı; öteki adaylar başka eklem, kemik, beden kusuru veya uzak kardeş anlamlarla sınırlıydı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kasık kıllarının çıktığı bölgeyi veya üreme organı çevresindeki etli kısmı gösterir, fakat kadınlara özgü olup olmadığı konusunda açık bir kaynak ayrılığı taşır. Dal korunabilir; cinsiyet sınırı kesinleştirilmeden ve bölge adı ile örtmeceli organ gönderimi birbirine indirgenmeden anlatılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, kasık ve üreme organı çevresindeki beden bölgesidir; kadınlara özgülük bazı tanıklıklarda vardır, bazılarında her iki cinsiyeti kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın beden bölgesi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka kuruluşlardan cinsel eylem, hastalık veya beden kusuru anlamı alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kasık kıllarının çıktığı bölge veya üreme organının çevresindeki etli kısımdır; kimi kullanımlarda kadın üreme organını örtmeceli biçimde de gösterebilir. Kaynaklar bunun yalnızca kadınlara mı yoksa her iki cinsiyete mi ait olduğu konusunda ayrılır.

facets.statement: Kasık kıllarının çıktığı yer ve üreme organı çevresindeki etli beden bölgesi temel gönderimdir.
Kadın üreme organını dolaylı biçimde gösteren bir örtmece olarak kullanılabilir.
Bazı tanıklıklar gönderimi kadınlarla sınırlar, bazıları erkek ve kadın için ortak kabul eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt kasık ve üreme organı çevresindeki beden bölgesinde birleşir; kadın organı için örtmeceli kullanım ile bu adın kadınlara özgü olup olmadığına ilişkin ayrılık da aynı toplu kanıtta yer alır.

concept_gloss.text: kasık ve üreme organı çevresindeki beden bölgesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Bölgesel beden gönderimini cinsiyet konusunda kesin hüküm vermeden karşılar ve örtmeceli kullanımın temelini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Kasık bölgesini, çevredeki etli kısmı ve cinsiyet sınırındaki belirsizliği korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Beden bölgesinin doğrudan ve cinsiyetten bağımsız biçimde anlatıldığı bağlamlarda en doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kasık kıllarının çıktığı beden bölgesini açık biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Üreme organı çevresindeki etli kısmı ve kadın organına yönelik örtmeceli kullanımı tam belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kasık kıllarının çıktığı bölge veya üreme organı çevresindeki etli kısım

error_profile.preserves: Örtmeceli kullanımın yöneldiği beden alanını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kasık kıllarının çıktığı çevre bölgesini ve etli kısmı tek organa indirger.
error_profile.collision: Bölge adı ile organ adını özdeşleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kasık kıllarının çıktığı bölgeyi ve çevredeki etli kısmı özellikle gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki bacak arasını ve insanların ya da hayvanların örtülmesi gereken organlarını daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kasık bölgesi ile iki bacak arası
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da üreme organları çevresindeki mahrem beden alanını ve örtmeceli anlatımı kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal iki bacak arası ve örtülmesi gereken organlar bakımından daha geniştir; odak dal kasık kıllarının çıktığı bölge ve çevredeki etli kısım üzerinde yoğunlaşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kılın çıktığı beden bölgesini ve üreme organı çevresindeki eti adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Erkeğin üreme organı üzerinde çıkan kılların kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da üreme organı çevresindeki kıl ve kılın çıktığı bölgeyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal öncelikle beden bölgesidir; komşu dal ise o bölgede çıkan kılları adlandırır ve erkek gönderimini açıkça öne çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin en güçlü bölümü, hurma ağacının üstünde veya gövdesinde çıkan ve toprağa kök salmayan bağlı sürgündür. Başakta ilk çıkan parçalar ile kesilmiş yabani otun dip kısmı aynı toplu kanıtta daha dar bitki adları olarak yer alır; bunlar tek bir hurma sürgünü tanımına zorlanmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bitkisel adlandırmalarla sınırlıdır; hurmadaki bağlı ve köksüz sürgün çekirdektir, başağın öncü parçaları ile kesilmiş ot dibi ayrı bağlı kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hurma gövdesindeki sürgün genel bitki çekirdeği olarak korunur; başağın ilk parçaları yalnızca verilen söz öbeğinde, kesilmiş otun dibi ise kendi biçiminde geçerli tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hurma ağacının üstünde veya gövdesinde çıkıp ana gövdeye bağlı kalan ve toprağa kök salmayan sürgündür. Başağın ilk çıkan parçaları ile kesilmiş belirli bir yabani otun dip kısmı ayrı ve daha dar bitki kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Hurma ağacının üstünde veya gövdesinde çıkan sürgün ana gövdeye bağlıdır ve toprağa kök salmaz.
Başağın başlangıcında ilk beliren parçalar belirli bir söz öbeğinde adlandırılır.
Kesilmiş belirli bir yabani otun dip kısmı aynı dalda ayrı bir bitki adı olarak tanıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, hurma gövdesine bağlı ve toprağa kök salmayan sürgünü merkez alır; başağın ilk çıkan parçaları ile kesilmiş yabani otun dip kısmını ayrı ve daha dar bitki kullanımları olarak ekler.

concept_gloss.text: gövdeye bağlı köksüz sürgün ve bağlı bitki parçaları
concept_gloss.applicability: Hurma sürgününü merkezde tutar, fakat başağın ilk parçaları ile kesilmiş ot dibinin ayrı bağlı kullanımlar olduğunu da görünür kılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bağlı hurma sürgününü ve öteki iki özel bitki parçasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hurma ağacının üstünde veya gövdesinde çıkıp toprağa ulaşmayan sürgünün anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dalın en güçlü tanıklanan hurma sürgünü anlamını bütün koşullarıyla korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca kişinin soyunun, yetiştiği kökenin ve topluluğu içindeki konumunun saygınlığını bildiren belirli bir niteleme kuruluşunu verir. Geçici araç veya binme yeri anlamı burada etkin değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca kişiyi saygın soy ve toplumsal köken bakımından niteleyen kuruluşta geçerlidir; kökün yalın biçimine genel bir köken anlamı yüklenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca saygın köken bildiren sabit niteleme kuruluşuna bağlıdır; bu anlam tek başına kullanılan kök biçimlerine veya taşıt anlamına genelleştirilmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi önce bağdaki iki su kanalı arasındaki yüksek toprak sırtını verir, ardından aynı adın sıra halinde dikilmiş hurmalar ve ekili açık arazi için kullanıldığını ekler. Dal korunabilir, ancak arazi biçimi ile dikim düzeni ve ekili parsel tek bir fiziksel nesneymiş gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yüksek kanal arası sırt çekirdektir; sıra dikim ve ekili parsel kullanımları tarımsal alan içindeki ayrı uzantılardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kanallar arasındaki yüksek sırtı ve tanıklanan tarımsal uzantıları yalın dal içinde tutar; başka yer adları veya sulama yapıları eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir bağdaki iki su kanalı arasında yükselen toprak sırtıdır. Aynı ad, bir çizgi boyunca dikilmiş hurma ağaçları dizisi veya ekilmiş açık tarım parseli için de kullanılabilir.

facets.statement: Bağdaki iki su kanalı arasında çevresinden yüksek bir toprak sırtı bulunur.
Bir çizgi boyunca dikilmiş hurma ağaçları dizisi aynı adla anılabilir.
Ekilmiş açık bir tarım parseli de aynı adın daha geniş arazi kullanımını oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, iki bağ kanalı arasındaki yüksek sırtı temel anlam olarak verir ve sıra halinde dikilmiş hurmaları ile ekili açık parseli ayrı tarımsal uzantılar olarak kaydeder.

error_profile.loses: Sıra halinde dikilmiş hurmalar ve ekili parsel uzantılarını kapsamaz.
